## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass (`make test`) and, if a task changed, it grades its own correct
      answer PASS and a wrong one FAIL.
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or the curriculum changed (`docs/`, `README.md`,
      `docs/masvs-coverage.md`).
- [ ] No secrets or real data committed; intentionally-vulnerable code stays in
      `apps/` / `vulnapi/` / `tasks/`.
